keywords: The Plaintiff sought recovery under an Advance Payment Bond (APB) and Performance Bond issued by the Defendant following a contractor\'s breach of a construction contract. Held — an On-Demand Performance Bond operates akin to a promissory note payable on demand and must be honored unless clear fraud is established with evidence; the APB was not restricted to recovery of advance payment alone but covered any loss arising from contractor\'s breach; Appellant failed to establish fraud; appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
